title: Explain local scope in clear technical English
difficulty_rationale: A learner only needs one small Luau example and an accurate distinction between a local name and an unintended global-looking assignment.
task_depth_rationale: The response is intentionally bounded to a single function and one terminology clarification.
user_request:
Explain in plain technical English why this Luau function should use `local` for its temporary counter. Show a corrected version, say what scope means here, and avoid unrelated Roblox services.

```luau
function totalItems(items)
    count = 0
    for _, item in items do
        count += 1
    end
    return count
end
```
avoid: claiming local makes a value immutable

title: Write a precise API contract explanation
difficulty_rationale: The answer must distinguish a function contract, invalid input handling, and example call behavior without relying on Roblox-specific context.
task_depth_rationale: Several linked requirements test requirements-following and clear technical phrasing.
user_request: Draft a compact API note for a Luau module function named `formatCoins(amount: number): string`. State its input/output contract, give two examples, explain how the caller should handle a negative value, and provide a short implementation. Do not silently change the requested function name or add Roblox services.

title: Validate a typed inventory table

Include type annotations when useful and briefly explain why `type(value) == "number"` alone does not prove the quantity is valid.

difficulty_rationale: A secure purchase path requires distrust of client input, server-owned prices and balances, rate limiting, and an outcome protocol.

The server must own the catalog price and balance, validate productId, reject spam, avoid double grants, and return a user-facing result without trusting `displayedPrice`. Include a small code example and list the security checks it performs.
requirements: Treat all client values as untrusted

title: Follow exact save-slot requirements

task_depth_rationale: It uses a constrained specification with several observable acceptance criteria and a required non-goal.

Include a small Luau example plus a checklist mapping each rule to the code.
requirements: Enforce the stated slotName character and length rule

title: Review a UI connection lifecycle bug
difficulty_rationale: The code has a subtle repeated-event connection leak that needs lifecycle reasoning and a safe repair strategy.
task_depth_rationale: The answer must identify the symptom, explain the cause, provide a repair, and state how to verify it.
user_request:
Review this LocalScript pattern. Each time a shop panel opens, it connects the same BuyButton again:

```luau
shopPanel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
    if shopPanel.Visible then
        buyButton.Activated:Connect(function()
            PurchaseRequest:FireServer("Potion")
        end)
    end
end)
```

Explain the subtle bug, provide a corrected lifecycle pattern, preserve the rule that the server validates any purchase, and describe one manual verification step.
avoid: claiming the UI can authorize purchases
